title: Map of Ashoka Pillar relocation route
subject: Geography
caption: Relocation route of the Ashoka Pillar from Topra to Delhi (1356 CE)
altText: A textbook‑style map on a white background showing northern India with two highlighted locations: Topra in the Pong Valley marked by a blue dot labeled “Topra – Original Site”, and Delhi marked by a green dot labeled “Delhi – Current Location”. A thick red line connects the two points, labeled “1356 CE relocation path”. A small compass rose in the upper left indicates north, and a scale bar at the bottom provides distance reference. All labels are clear and the geography is accurate, presented in high‑resolution detail.
